title: Valid Parentheses
statement:
Given a string `s` containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.

A string is valid if open brackets are closed by the same type of bracket, in the correct order, and every close bracket has a matching open.

Example: s = "()[]{}" -> True; s = "(]" -> False
hints: A stack is the natural tool: push opening brackets, pop on closing ones.
When you see a closing bracket, the top of the stack must be its matching opener.
At the end the stack must be empty. A closing bracket with an empty stack is an instant False.
complexity: Time O(n), one pass. Space O(n) for the stack in the worst case.
